custom_definitions: Only candle data from the three listed venues counts; a 1-minute candle HIGH (the wick) is what is read, not the close.
Fallback: if one named venue is unavailable the remaining venues must confirm; if fewer than two can be checked the outcome is VOID.
Early YES resolution is allowed at the first qualifying confirmed candle, never before; otherwise the outcome is decided at the window end.
If the evidence cannot establish the claim, the outcome is VOID.
_source_class_note: Kraken is mapped to evidence.py's 'data' tier (CLASS_RANK=2) purely so the engine's existing tier mechanism (try tier 1 first, fall through to tier 2 only if tier 1 is insufficient/absent) implements the fallback rule for free, without a 'fallback' tier name the shared CLASS_RANK dict doesn't define.
